description: Find programs by CIP code across institutions, ranked by median earnings within the fetched school page. Accepts school-side filters (state, ownership, max cost). Minimum earnings is applied locally; totals and pagination count schools before local program filtering. Use scorecard_lookup_cip to convert program names to CIP codes. Returns school names and IDs alongside program earnings, cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS debt, and IPEDS awards for follow-up calls to scorecard_get_school or scorecard_get_programs.

cip_code.description: CIP 4-digit code to search for (e.g. "11.07" for Computer Science). Use scorecard_lookup_cip to find codes.

credential_level.description: Provider credential selector: 1=undergraduate certificate, 2=associate, 3=bachelor, 4=post-baccalaureate certificate, 5=master, 6=doctoral, 7=first professional, 8=graduate/professional certificate, 99=non-credential; other integer levels may return no matches.

max_debt.description: Maximum median cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS debt across institutions at the same academic level, inclusive; excludes unavailable debt.

max_net_price.description: Maximum average net price at the school.

min_earnings.description: Minimum 1-year median earnings, inclusive. Filters this school page locally and excludes unavailable earnings; school totals are unchanged.

per_page.description: Schools per page (max 100); program rows may exceed this count.

program_name.description: Case-insensitive title substring matched within the fetched school page. Ignored when cip_code is provided; use cip_code for upstream program matching.

state.description: Comma-separated two-letter state codes; case and whitespace normalized, blanks unset.

name: scorecard_search_programs

cap.description: The per_page limit that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no programs match or earnings data is unavailable.

programs.description: Program rows retain separate credential identities, sorted by earnings descending with unavailable or privacy-suppressed earnings last.

credential_level.description: Provider credential level; unknown future numeric levels are retained.

earnings_1yr_median.description: Median earnings of graduates working and not enrolled 1 year after their highest credential.

earnings_availability.description: Available number, unavailable with unknown cause, or confirmed privacy suppression.

ipeds_awards_year1.description: IPEDS awards in year 1 of the pooled debt cohort; awards, not enrollment or unique students.

ipeds_awards_year2.description: IPEDS awards in year 2 of the pooled debt cohort; awards, not enrollment or unique students.

median_debt.description: Median cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS borrowing among completers across attended institutions at the same academic level.

net_price_overall.description: Average net price at this school.

school_id.description: School unit ID — use for follow-up calls.

school_ownership.description: Control type: Public, Private nonprofit, or For-profit.

suppressed.description: True only for explicit provider privacy markers.

query.description: Normalized effective selectors and pagination defaults.

total.description: Total schools matching upstream filters, before pagination and local program filtering.

totalCount.description: Total schools matching upstream filters, before pagination and local program filtering.

total_programs.description: Total programs returned across all result schools.

truncated.description: True when school pagination metadata indicates a later page exists.

unavailable_count.description: Programs with unavailable earnings of unknown cause.

title: Search Programs
